title: Train a trace-to-state-machine induction RLM

donor_sources.observation: Induction requests a textual generalization and possible counterexamples; it does not infer executable state machines from traces.

mechanism: Learn root programs that partition traces, infer executable transition systems, and validate them on unseen sequences.
challenge: Identical output prefixes followed by different legal continuations must not be merged into one state.

title: Train an active protocol-learning RLM

donor_sources.observation: The donor generates retrieval queries over notes; it has no membership-query or equivalence-counterexample protocol-learning loop.

mechanism: Learn economical root query programs that identify an opaque resettable tool protocol.
challenge: A retry that consumes a token changes protocol state even though its visible response matches a harmless retry.

title: Train an executable API-contract mining RLM

donor_sources.observation: AST inspection extracts declarations and arguments; registration validates syntax but does not infer behavioral preconditions or postconditions.

mechanism: Learn root decompositions that turn implementations and examples into executable, falsifiable API contracts.
challenge: A nonempty output is not success when the API contract requires a matching request identity and sorted records.

title: Train minimal causal-feature discovery for failures

donor_sources.observation: Causality is requested as generated text; the workflow leaves causal analysis unimplemented rather than discovering causal features through interventions.

mechanism: Learn root programs that isolate small intervention-supported feature sets explaining procedure failures.
challenge: A timestamp correlated with crashes must lose to the actual ownership-state feature when interventions separate them.

title: Train quality-diversity search over rewrite behaviors

donor_sources.observation: The donor selects individual define, compose, inspect or transform actions; it maintains no behavior-space archive or learned diversity-seeking search policy.

mechanism: Learn root search programs that maintain independently qualified behavioral niches instead of one brittle champion.
challenge: An extremely fast candidate on uniform inputs must not erase a robust candidate needed for skewed workloads.

title: Train constrained Bayesian compiler-search programs

donor_sources.observation: Strategy selection multiplies fixed confidence values by hand-written mode weights; it does not learn acquisition decisions from compiler measurements.

mechanism: Learn root orchestration of fitted surrogate models and constrained acquisitions over compiler settings.
challenge: An aggressive flag combination with excellent speed but incorrect overflow behavior must remain infeasible.

title: Train propensity-aware contextual exploration

donor_sources.observation: Strategies use hand-assigned confidences and fixed weights; there are no logged action propensities or counterfactual policy estimates.

mechanism: Learn root programs for constrained contextual exploration with valid propensity logs and off-policy evaluation.
challenge: A policy favored only because easy tasks received its actions must fail a properly weighted comparison.

title: Train pairwise ranking of rewrite candidates

donor_sources.observation: The selector sorts fixed confidence-weight products rather than learning rankings from controlled pairwise outcomes.

mechanism: Learn root comparison programs and candidate rankings from independent paired outcomes with ties and incompatibility.
challenge: A verbose candidate rationale cannot beat a concise candidate with stronger matched-workload evidence.

title: Train compositional task generation from capability grammars

donor_sources.observation: Composition chains named callables but does not generate typed challenge distributions or verify task solvability from capability grammars.

mechanism: Learn root programs that generate solvable, oracle-backed compositions testing new runtime capabilities.
challenge: A generated challenge must not require an unavailable capability or hide an impossible postcondition behind fluent wording.

title: Train adversarial coevolution with a protected referee

donor_sources.observation: Bias critique is generated text and final synthesis remains the original multi-strategy synthesis; no adversary learns tests against an independent executable referee.

mechanism: Train a root adversary to generate valid counterexamples while preserving a separate immutable referee.
challenge: A test that merely changes the specification or crashes the harness must not earn credit for defeating a candidate.

title: Train executable invariant discovery with held-out checking

donor_sources.observation: The signatures request laws and validity labels from an LM; they do not discover executable predicates and verify them against unseen transitions.

mechanism: Learn root programs that propose bounded invariants and refine them with executable counterexamples.
challenge: An invariant learned from positive counters must fail when a hidden wraparound transition violates it.

title: Train error-cluster curriculum scheduling

donor_sources.observation: Adjustment checks a tool success-rate threshold and emits generic alternatives; it does not learn curriculum choices from structured error clusters.

mechanism: Learn root programs that choose training episodes from error structure and measured learning progress.
challenge: A huge duplicate cluster of easy failures must not consume all training while a small catastrophic class is forgotten.

title: Train abstract-interpretation-guided candidate bounding

donor_sources.observation: The AST analyzer extracts declarations and syntax structure; it does not compute abstract states or bound candidate execution.

mechanism: Learn root programs that select sound abstract domains and refinement steps around a trusted analysis engine.
challenge: A rare loop-growth path must not be certified bounded because sampled traces terminate.

title: Train semantic indexing by executable behavior

donor_sources.observation: Registry discovery exposes names, descriptions and AST metadata; it does not index procedures by independently observed input/output behavior.

mechanism: Learn root probing and retrieval programs that identify procedures by behavioral signatures and counterexamples.
challenge: Two similarly named functions differing only on empty input must remain distinguishable in retrieval.

title: Train uncertainty-aware surrogate performance reasoning

donor_sources.observation: The workflow passes fixed prior 0.5 and placeholder likelihood 0.8; it does not fit performance-response models or evaluate their uncertainty on observations.

mechanism: Learn root programs that fit and challenge real conditional performance surrogates for novel candidates.
challenge: A surrogate trained on small arrays must flag unsupported extrapolation to cache-thrashing sizes.

title: Train amortized experiment-selection policies

donor_sources.observation: Immediate actions take the first few selected tools and next steps are generic strings; no policy is learned from experiment outcomes.

mechanism: Learn root experiment-selection programs across tasks instead of recomputing only a supplied analytic value table.
challenge: A memorized cheap probe must be rejected when its result cannot distinguish the current hypotheses.

title: Train hierarchical skill-option induction

donor_sources.observation: Actions have dependencies and completion status, but there is no learned initiation set, reusable subpolicy or termination condition for a temporal option.

mechanism: Learn root segmentation and synthesis of reusable options with checked initiation and termination behavior.
challenge: A retry-until-success fragment must not become an unbounded skill that runs after its preconditions stop holding.

title: Train online concept-drift segmentation

donor_sources.observation: Strategy adjustment uses aggregate tool success-rate thresholds; it does not infer changing regimes or distinguish drift from isolated failures.

mechanism: Learn root programs that detect latent operating-regime changes and select scoped relearning actions.
challenge: A single outlier must not trigger a new regime, while a persistent shifted workload must not be averaged away.

title: Train compression-driven reusable procedure libraries

donor_sources.observation: Composition joins named callables and transformations are hand-authored; the donor does not extract a reusable library by jointly compressing many programs.

mechanism: Learn root programs that discover shared abstractions minimizing checked description length across a corpus.
challenge: A short library that memorizes training constants or changes effect order must lose despite excellent apparent compression.

title: Train transfer attribution and negative-transfer prevention

donor_sources.observation: Analogy requests similarities and inferred features from an LM; it does not measure whether transferred learning improves independent target tasks.

mechanism: Learn root programs that design transfer ablations and reject source knowledge causing target regressions.
challenge: A transferred caching skill that helps pure transforms but corrupts stateful counters must be rejected for the latter target.
